title: Create video player page with player, metadata, comments, and related videos

requirements.text: Update VideoPlayer page to display a large HTML5 video player at the top of the page when a video card is clicked

quotes: navigate to a view that features a large HTML5 Video Player

acceptanceCriteria: Video player is prominently displayed at the top of the page
Player uses HTML5 video element
Video plays when user clicks on a video card from the homepage

requirements.text: Display video title in bold below the video player
acceptanceCriteria: Video title is displayed below the player
Title text is bold
Title matches the video metadata

requirements.text: Add a Subscribe button next to the channel name below the video player

quotes: a 'Subscribe' button next to the channel name

acceptanceCriteria: Subscribe button appears next to the channel name
Button is visually distinct and clickable
Backend tracks subscription relationships between users and channels
Button shows subscribed state if user is already subscribed

requirements.text: Add an expandable description box below the video metadata that can be collapsed and expanded

quotes: a description box that can expand

acceptanceCriteria: Description box is initially collapsed or truncated
User can click to expand the full description
User can collapse the description after expanding
Description content matches video metadata

requirements.text: Add a Comments Section at the bottom of the video player page with a text input for 'Add a comment'

quotes: Add a Comments Section at the bottom with a text input for 'Add a comment'

acceptanceCriteria: Comments section is positioned at the bottom of the page
Text input field is labeled 'Add a comment'
Existing comments are displayed above the input
New comments appear after submission

requirements.text: Display a list of Related Videos on the right side of the video player in a smaller vertical list format

quotes: show a list of 'Related Videos' in a smaller vertical list format

acceptanceCriteria: Related videos list appears on the right side of the player
Videos are displayed in a vertical list format
Video cards are smaller than the main homepage grid cards
Clicking a related video navigates to that video's player page
List shows at least 5-10 related videos

constraints: Use existing CommentSection component for comments functionality
Maintain existing VideoPlayer page structure and routing from frontend/src/pages/VideoPlayer.tsx
Keep existing video metadata fetching logic using useVideo hook
Preserve dark mode theme with red accent colors
nonGoals: Video recommendation algorithm (use simple related videos logic like same uploader or recent videos)
Advanced video player controls beyond HTML5 defaults
